title: Godot4.4.1菜单与玩法输入分流：真实暂停及键盘恢复
source_note: 官方Godot4.4技术事实摘要与真实4.4.1运行，工程/消息/玩法R2均原创；非官方游戏或发布规范。
instruction:
# Godot4.4.1菜单与玩法输入分流：真实暂停及键盘恢复

## 业务场景与任务说明

你接手一个原创Godot原型：UI点击会先触发世界开火，暂停后路由/菜单又失灵。R1背景关闭草案已被R2替换，而更晚的外包建议想删交互赶工。请修完整可运行工程，保留世界输入、菜单、暂停、滑块、文本及键盘恢复，实测而非全局禁用输入。

业务判断基准时点：2025-06-16 10:00；时区：Asia/Shanghai。检索/下载时间不是政策生效时间。

## 可使用的源文件

以下输入均位于只读目录`/app/input_files/`。无需联网补充事实；使用冻结材料完成交付。
- `/app/input_files/starter_game/project.godot`：原创4.4.1待修工程源码；只读输入，复制后修复。
- `/app/input_files/starter_game/main.tscn`：原创4.4.1待修工程源码；只读输入，复制后修复。
- `/app/input_files/starter_game/main.gd`：原创4.4.1待修工程源码；只读输入，复制后修复。
- `/app/input_files/starter_game/world.gd`：原创4.4.1待修工程源码；只读输入，复制后修复。
- `/app/input_files/S01_Godot4_4依据摘要.docx`：作者中文摘要/精确4.4官方链接及抓取/许可边界，非完整官方译文。
- `/app/input_files/S02_原创变更与验收.docx`：原创R1/R2/晚未批准建议及六组行为/交付合同，不是官方玩法规则。

## 工作要求

- [Q1] 交可独立运行的Godot4.4.1修复工程，保留世界左键/Space开火、Right步进与真实HUD，无UI处不能全屏吞输入。
- [Q2] GUI先于玩法消费：菜单按钮/装饰点击不附带开火；R2背景吸收、不关闭；不能全部IGNORE造成穿透。
- [Q3] 菜单使用真实暂停，世界tick/输入停而UI继续，不能删暂停或全局停输入。
- [Q4] 滑块、文本、鼠标/Enter恢复与Esc单次非echo开关均可用，UI按键不触发玩法。
- [Q5] 恢复后玩法重新工作，计数/设置保留；两窗口尺寸布局均可交互。
- [Q6] 交源码、实际引擎事件回放及观察JSON、交接说明，覆盖前述要求且不编未跑检查/设备/发布结论；输入只读，最终目录无缓存。

## 交付物要求

只将以下最终交付写入`/app/output/`。
- `/app/output/fixed_game/project.godot`：修复工程源码/真实事件回放脚本；独立可运行，不含缓存。
- `/app/output/fixed_game/main.tscn`：修复工程源码/真实事件回放脚本；独立可运行，不含缓存。
- `/app/output/fixed_game/main.gd`：修复工程源码/真实事件回放脚本；独立可运行，不含缓存。
- `/app/output/fixed_game/world.gd`：修复工程源码/真实事件回放脚本；独立可运行，不含缓存。
- `/app/output/fixed_game/input_probe.gd`：修复工程源码/真实事件回放脚本；独立可运行，不含缓存。
- `/app/output/input_evidence.json`：真实引擎观察/哈希/失败与范围，不是评分或设备普适结论。
- `/app/output/handoff.md`：R2取舍、技术修复、复现命令和未验范围的交接。

## 硬约束（单独列明）

- 只交规定7个物理文件到/app/output/，不加压缩包或生成缓存；修改的是复制工程，不动输入。
- Godot4.4.1；不得以更换引擎、删玩法/键盘/控件或不暂停世界绕过要求。
- R2是最终有权要求，R1和外包晚建议不可替代；素材/代码/消息均为原创训练情境。
- 可以改内部结构/视觉，不固定变量名或逐字代码；回放必须真实注入/观察，不伪造外部QA或设备/发布通过。

sections.text:
extends Node2D

var world: Node2D
var menu_button: Button
var overlay: ColorRect
var panel: Panel
var resume_button: Button
var volume: HSlider
var alias_field: LineEdit
var hud: Label
var menu_open := false

func _ready() -> void:
    process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE
    world = load("res://world.gd").new()
    world.name = "World"
    add_child(world)
    var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
    add_child(layer)
    var ui := Control.new()
    layer.add_child(ui)
    ui.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
    ui.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
    menu_button = Button.new()
    menu_button.name = "MenuButton"
    menu_button.text = "      PAUSE / ESC"
    menu_button.position = Vector2(24,24)
    menu_button.size = Vector2(160,44)
    ui.add_child(menu_button)
    menu_button.pressed.connect(func(): set_menu(true))
    var icon := ColorRect.new()
    icon.name = "DecorativeIcon"
    icon.color = Color("56d6be")
    icon.position = Vector2(12,14)
    icon.size = Vector2(14,16)
    icon.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
    menu_button.add_child(icon)
    hud = Label.new()
    hud.position = Vector2(24,84)
    hud.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
    ui.add_child(hud)
    overlay = ColorRect.new()
    overlay.name = "ModalBackdrop"
    overlay.color = Color(0.01,0.025,0.05,0.88)
    overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
    ui.add_child(overlay)
    overlay.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
    overlay.gui_input.connect(func(event):
        if event is InputEventMouse: overlay.accept_event())
    panel = Panel.new()
    panel.name = "SettingsPanel"
    overlay.add_child(panel)
    panel.size = Vector2(360,300)
    var title := Label.new()
    title.text = "PAUSED  /  INPUT HARBOUR"
    title.position = Vector2(24,22)
    title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",19)
    title.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
    panel.add_child(title)
    var description := Label.new()
    description.text = "UI stays live. World waits.\nBackdrop clicks are absorbed."
    description.position = Vector2(24,57)
    description.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
    panel.add_child(description)
    volume = HSlider.new()
    volume.name = "Volume"
    volume.position = Vector2(24,112)
    volume.size = Vector2(312,30)
    volume.min_value = 0
    volume.max_value = 100
    volume.step = 5
    volume.value = 35
    panel.add_child(volume)
    alias_field = LineEdit.new()
    alias_field.name = "AliasField"
    alias_field.placeholder_text = "Optional local alias (not saved online)"
    alias_field.position = Vector2(24,159)
    alias_field.size = Vector2(312,38)
    panel.add_child(alias_field)
    resume_button = Button.new()
    resume_button.name = "ResumeButton"
    resume_button.text = "RESUME  /  ENTER"
    resume_button.position = Vector2(24,222)
    resume_button.size = Vector2(312,46)
    panel.add_child(resume_button)
    resume_button.pressed.connect(func(): set_menu(false))
    volume.focus_next = volume.get_path_to(alias_field)
    alias_field.focus_next = alias_field.get_path_to(resume_button)
    resume_button.focus_next = resume_button.get_path_to(volume)
    get_viewport().size_changed.connect(_layout)
    _layout()
    overlay.hide()

func _layout() -> void:
    panel.position = (get_viewport_rect().size - panel.size) / 2
    world.queue_redraw()

func set_menu(value: bool) -> void:
    menu_open = value
    overlay.visible = value
    get_tree().paused = value
    if value:
        resume_button.grab_focus()
    else:
        get_viewport().gui_release_focus()

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
    if event is InputEventKey and event.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE and event.pressed and not event.echo:
        set_menu(not menu_open)
        get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:

范围/真实版本
原创团队/代码/缺陷/消息，非真实客户工程。重放业务基准2025-06-16 10:00 Asia/Shanghai。你是Godot 4.4.1 UI/玩法程序员，修输入分流而非更换引擎、重做玩法或用报告代替可运行代码。starter_game的四个源文件是可编辑副本的起点；输入本体只读。
入口main.tscn。最小玩法：世界左键/Space记一次开火、Right移动一步；HUD显示真实计数。菜单有滑块和本地文本框。窗口640×480、960×640均需可用。计数是观测接口，不是假测试分数；允许等价实现和内部变量/节点命名。
时序和有效权限
6月10日R1草案：点击任意背景关闭菜单，只需鼠标可用，原型把玩法放_input；此草案未保留为最终验收。
6月16日09:00主设计R2：背景点击只吸收、不关闭；按钮装饰不抢点击；暂停时玩法物理/输入停，菜单鼠标、键盘、滑块和文本仍活；Esc无回声重复切换，恢复后设置保留、玩法重新工作。R2是本题有权最终要求。
6月16日09:30外包建议：全局关闭输入、去掉暂停状态或删除滑块/文本以便赶工。外包无权降级R2，未获设计负责人批准，不能因消息更晚采用。
六组验收要求
Q1：可独立打开运行的4.4.1工程，保留点击/Space开火、Right步进与真实HUD；无UI活动时不能把整个HUD当全屏输入黑洞。
Q2：点击菜单按钮包括装饰图标区域只开菜单、不额外开火；菜单背景点击被吸收且不关菜单；不把全部控件设IGNORE导致穿透。
Q3：菜单开时SceneTree处于paused，玩法tick与输入停止；UI继续工作。不能通过不暂停世界或全局关闭输入取巧。
Q4：暂停菜单可改滑块、录文本、鼠标恢复/Enter恢复；键盘用于UI时不移动/开火；Esc开关忽略echo和release，不能一次按键重复切换。
Q5：恢复后玩法输入重新工作、已有计数不重置；再次打开保留滑块/文本。两个窗口尺寸都可用，不把控件挪到屏外。
Q6：交完整修复源码、真实引擎事件回放JSON和简明交接。记录实际检查/失败，不以静态grep或固定“pass”文件冒充。说明R2取舍、输入先后、暂停/焦点处理、复现命令、未验范围。
交付边界

交fixed_game/project.godot、main.tscn、main.gd、world.gd、input_probe.gd，以及input_evidence.json、handoff.md。文件在/app/output/下，不交.godot缓存、.uid、引擎二进制、压缩包或无关素材。input_probe.gd为你交付的可复现真实事件回放脚本；允许等价内部实现，但需输出每项实际观察和成功/失败，至少覆盖两尺寸全部六组行为。
鼠标/键盘事件可由Viewport注入到真实引擎；这不等于物理设备、OS事件、手机/手柄、所有DPI、平台导出或发布通过。未实际执行的范围保持未验，不编外部QA签字或线上发布。

extends SceneTree

var app: Node
var checks: Array[Dictionary] = []

func _initialize() -> void:
    call_deferred("run")

func settle() -> void:
    await process_frame
    await process_frame

func record(name: String, passed: bool, observed: Dictionary) -> void:
    checks.append({"name": name, "pass": passed, "observed": observed})

func click(at: Vector2) -> void:
    var motion := InputEventMouseMotion.new()
    motion.position = at
    root.push_input(motion, true)
    for down in [true, false]:
        var event := InputEventMouseButton.new()
        event.position = at
        event.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
        event.pressed = down
        root.push_input(event, true)
        await process_frame

func key(code: Key, unicode_value: int = 0, echo_value: bool = false) -> void:
    for down in [true, false]:
        var event := InputEventKey.new()
        event.keycode = code
        event.unicode = unicode_value
        event.pressed = down
        event.echo = echo_value if down else false
        root.push_input(event, true)
        await process_frame

func center(control: Control) -> Vector2:
    return control.get_global_rect().get_center()

func suite(size_value: Vector2i) -> void:
    root.size = size_value
    app = load("res://main.tscn").instantiate()
    root.add_child(app)
    await settle()
    var tag := "%dx%d/" % [size_value.x, size_value.y]
    await click(Vector2(size_value.x-60,size_value.y-60))
    record(tag+"world_click", app.world.shots == 1, {"shots":app.world.shots})
    await click(app.menu_button.global_position+Vector2(18,22))
    record(tag+"icon_opens_without_shot", app.menu_open and paused and app.world.shots == 1, {"open":app.menu_open,"shots":app.world.shots})
    var tick_before: int = app.world.ticks
    await create_timer(0.12, true).timeout
    record(tag+"world_ticks_pause", app.world.ticks == tick_before, {"before":tick_before,"after":app.world.ticks})
    await click(Vector2(5,5))
    record(tag+"backdrop_does_not_close", app.menu_open and app.world.shots == 1, {"open":app.menu_open,"shots":app.world.shots})
    await click(app.volume.global_position+Vector2(260,15))
    var changed: float = app.volume.value
    record(tag+"slider_works_paused", changed != 35 and paused, {"value":changed})
    var before_steps: int = app.world.steps
    await key(KEY_RIGHT)
    record(tag+"slider_key_not_world", app.world.steps == before_steps, {"steps":app.world.steps,"volume":app.volume.value})
    await click(center(app.alias_field))
    await key(KEY_X, 120)
    record(tag+"text_works_paused", app.alias_field.text == "x" and app.world.shots == 1, {"text":app.alias_field.text,"shots":app.world.shots})
    var remembered: float = app.volume.value
    await key(KEY_ESCAPE)
    record(tag+"escape_resumes", not app.menu_open and not paused and app.world.shots == 1, {"open":app.menu_open,"shots":app.world.shots})
    await key(KEY_RIGHT)
    record(tag+"world_key_restored", app.world.steps == before_steps+1, {"steps":app.world.steps})
    await key(KEY_SPACE,32)
    record(tag+"space_fire_restored", app.world.shots == 2, {"shots":app.world.shots})
    await key(KEY_ESCAPE)
    await key(KEY_ESCAPE,0,true)
    record(tag+"echo_not_toggle", app.menu_open and paused, {"open":app.menu_open})
    record(tag+"settings_persist", app.volume.value == remembered and app.alias_field.text == "x", {"volume":app.volume.value,"text":app.alias_field.text})
    await click(center(app.resume_button))
    record(tag+"resume_click_no_shot", not app.menu_open and not paused and app.world.shots == 2, {"open":app.menu_open,"shots":app.world.shots})
    await key(KEY_ESCAPE)
    await key(KEY_ENTER)
    record(tag+"enter_resume", not app.menu_open and not paused, {"open":app.menu_open})
    await click(Vector2(38,92))
    record(tag+"decorative_hud_not_fullscreen_block", app.world.shots == 3, {"shots":app.world.shots})
    app.queue_free()
    await settle()

func run() -> void:
    await suite(Vector2i(640,480))
    await suite(Vector2i(960,640))
    var passed := true
    for row in checks:
        passed = passed and row["pass"]
    print("GA002_EVIDENCE="+JSON.stringify({"engine":Engine.get_version_info().string,"checks":checks,"pass":passed,"scope":"Actual injected viewport events; not OS/physical-device, export or solver acceptance."}))
    quit(0 if passed else 2)

extends Node2D

var world: Node2D
var menu_button: Button
var overlay: ColorRect
var panel: Panel
var resume_button: Button
var volume: HSlider
var alias_field: LineEdit
var hud: Label
var menu_open := false

func _ready() -> void:
    process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
    world = load("res://world.gd").new()
    world.name = "World"
    add_child(world)
    var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
    add_child(layer)
    var ui := Control.new()
    layer.add_child(ui)
    ui.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
    ui.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
    menu_button = Button.new()
    menu_button.name = "MenuButton"
    menu_button.text = "      PAUSE / ESC"
    menu_button.position = Vector2(24,24)
    menu_button.size = Vector2(160,44)
    ui.add_child(menu_button)
    menu_button.pressed.connect(func(): set_menu(true))
    var icon := ColorRect.new()
    icon.name = "DecorativeIcon"
    icon.color = Color("56d6be")
    icon.position = Vector2(12,14)
    icon.size = Vector2(14,16)
    icon.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
    menu_button.add_child(icon)
    hud = Label.new()
    hud.position = Vector2(24,84)
    hud.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
    ui.add_child(hud)
    overlay = ColorRect.new()
    overlay.name = "ModalBackdrop"
    overlay.color = Color(0.01,0.025,0.05,0.88)
    overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
    ui.add_child(overlay)
    overlay.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
    overlay.gui_input.connect(func(event):
        if event is InputEventMouse: overlay.accept_event())
    panel = Panel.new()
    panel.name = "SettingsPanel"
    overlay.add_child(panel)
    panel.size = Vector2(360,300)
    var title := Label.new()
    title.text = "PAUSED  /  INPUT HARBOUR"
    title.position = Vector2(24,22)
    title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",19)
    title.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
    panel.add_child(title)
    var description := Label.new()
    description.text = "UI stays live. World waits.\nBackdrop clicks are absorbed."
    description.position = Vector2(24,57)
    description.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
    panel.add_child(description)
    volume = HSlider.new()
    volume.name = "Volume"
    volume.position = Vector2(24,112)
    volume.size = Vector2(312,30)
    volume.min_value = 0
    volume.max_value = 100
    volume.step = 5
    volume.value = 35
    panel.add_child(volume)
    alias_field = LineEdit.new()
    alias_field.name = "AliasField"
    alias_field.placeholder_text = "Optional local alias (not saved online)"
    alias_field.position = Vector2(24,159)
    alias_field.size = Vector2(312,38)
    panel.add_child(alias_field)
    resume_button = Button.new()
    resume_button.name = "ResumeButton"
    resume_button.text = "RESUME  /  ENTER"
    resume_button.position = Vector2(24,222)
    resume_button.size = Vector2(312,46)
    panel.add_child(resume_button)
    resume_button.pressed.connect(func(): set_menu(false))
    volume.focus_next = volume.get_path_to(alias_field)
    alias_field.focus_next = alias_field.get_path_to(resume_button)
    resume_button.focus_next = resume_button.get_path_to(volume)
    get_viewport().size_changed.connect(_layout)
    _layout()
    overlay.hide()

func _layout() -> void:
    panel.position = (get_viewport_rect().size - panel.size) / 2
    world.queue_redraw()

func set_menu(value: bool) -> void:
    menu_open = value
    overlay.visible = value
    get_tree().paused = value
    if value:
        resume_button.grab_focus()
    else:
        get_viewport().gui_release_focus()

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
    if event is InputEventKey and event.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE and event.pressed and not event.echo:
        set_menu(not menu_open)
        get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
    hud.text = "INPUT HARBOUR · LOCAL PROTOTYPE\nShots: %d    Steps: %d\nWorld: click / Space to fire · Right to step\nPause: ESC · slider, text and keyboard still work" % [world.shots, world.steps]

# Input Harbour 输入修复交接

基准为原创2025-06-16 R2；不是后来外包建议或6月10日R1。目标Godot4.4.1，无外部素材、插件或网络请求。

玩法从`_input`移到`_unhandled_input`，先让GUI消费事件；不通过禁用全部输入制造假修复。World为PAUSABLE，主UI路由为ALWAYS；菜单用真实SceneTree.paused。Esc在前置输入仅处理非echo的pressed并消费；其余玩法仍留后置阶段。菜单背景STOP并消费鼠标，按钮上装饰IGNORE；UI根不吞世界点击。恢复时释放GUI焦点，不重建/重置玩法节点，设置保留。

真实回放：`godot --headless --path fixed_game --script res://input_probe.gd`。两窗口640×480/960×640各15项；JSON记录实际shots、steps、ticks、value、text、menu状态。tick绝对值受机器影响，只比较暂停区间前后不变。主场景可直接在编辑器F6或命令行运行交互，不是仅打印测试结果。

官方依据见S01的Godot4.4输入、暂停、Control文档，核心取舍由S02原创R2定义。源码/事件回放结果是本地候选；未验物理鼠标/键盘、OS事件、移动/手柄、多DPI、导出、平台发布或外部QA签字，production_release=false。不把模拟事件通过说成所有设备通过。
